note: Generation manifest for character portraits. The script composes each prompt as style.prefix + character.subject + style.suffix. Keep one unified style across all entries so the cast reads as one set. Sprites are generated with background=transparent for stage compositing; regenerate all portraits and re-run emit-presence after changing the style.
